series: neutral Fe(II) complexes with a fixed tetradentate ligand and three specified cis monodentate pseudohalide variants

common_ligand.connectivity: a neutral tertiary amine N is bonded to two pyridin-2-ylmethyl groups and one (5-phenyl-1,3,4-thiadiazol-2-yl)methyl group; the Fe-binding donor set is the tertiary amine N, both pyridyl N atoms, and the thiadiazole ring N adjacent to substituted C2
common_ligand.formula_basis: source-supported ligand formula after removal of two pseudohalides

variants.auxiliary: two NCS- ligands, Fe-bound through terminal N
two NCSe- ligands, Fe-bound through terminal N
two NCBH3- ligands, Fe-bound through nitrile N

metal_center.coordination: octahedral cis; four LPh-TDA donors and two auxiliary N donors

quantity: E_el^iso = E(HS) - E(LS) between optimized states for each named variant, in kJ/mol
scope: independent computational investigation; no paper-specific method is prescribed
